x-openregister.description: Additive fragment (ADR-037; OpenSpec change ori-adoption, REQ-ORIA-002). Lets decidiq store council information migrated from an ORI register on its own Popolo-aligned schemas: two enum values on Meeting, one on GovernanceBody, documents on an agenda item, file facts on a document, party-level results and the decided subject on a voting round, seat count and coalition role on a body. Nothing is renamed or removed and no required list changes, so every stored object stays valid. externalReference is declared where a schema did not carry it yet, because the import tags each object it writes with ori:<source uuid> (REQ-ORIA-003).

externalReference.title: External reference
externalReference.description: Where this meeting was imported from, e.g. ori:<source uuid> for an object migrated from an ORI register. The idempotency key of the import: a re-run updates the object carrying it instead of creating another, and a rollback deletes by it. Empty for objects created in decidiq itself.
